prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity design comparison board for Palla, a native iPhone social padel app in Buenos Aires. Show THREE complete iPhone screens side by side on a plain warm neutral presentation background, frontal flat crisp screenshot-like UI, thin discreet device frames. Each phone screen 393x852 logical proportions, fully visible, top native status bar and bottom home indicator. Board labels OUTSIDE screens: "A · Category list", "B · Compact grid", "C · Guided choice". No extra explanations outside.
Preserve established design system: light canvas #fbf8ff, white surfaces, near-black #1a1b22, muted olive #444932, borders #c5c9ac, active selection pale lime #f7ffd5 with olive #536600 border, main CTA vivid lime #d4ff00 with dark text. Hanken Grotesk-like warm clean sans typography. 24px side padding, strong 30px headings, comfortable body text, 48px minimum controls, restrained 12px rounded corners, no gradients, no shadows, no illustrations, no decorative icons.
All screens share consistent navigation: back arrow at left, centered plain Palla wordmark, "3 of 3" at right. Heading "What’s your category?" supporting copy "Choose the category you usually play in." Small subtle helper "Lower numbers mean a higher playing level." Category names use Argentina notation, not decimal ratings. No claimed official rankings, no automatic beginner mapping.
Screen A recommended: tidy white bordered list with eight rows and radio circles, rows order "8va", "7ma", "6ta", "5ta", "4ta", "3ra", "2da", "1ra". Select 6ta, pale lime row and olive checked radio. Rows 48px high, list fits. Underneath two calm compact text choices "I’m just starting" and "Not sure yet" with unselected radio controls, not tiny text. Footer "You can update this from your profile." Main full width lime CTA "Start playing".
Screen B: identical heading/navigation/copy. A 2-column 4-row grid of category buttons 8va/7ma, 6ta/5ta, 4ta/3ra, 2da/1ra. Select 6ta pale lime olive border check. Below grid two full width compact radio rows "I’m just starting" and "Not sure yet". Use generous clear spacing, no unnecessary decorative containers. Footer same profile helper and lime "Start playing".
Screen C: identical navigation heading but supporting copy "You don’t need a tournament ranking to join." Three full width simple radio choices "I know my category" selected pale lime, "I’m just starting", "Not sure yet". Within selected choice, a white native picker-like field labeled "Your category" showing "6ta" with down chevron, plus calm olive link "Help me choose". Small caption "Your choice is self-reported." Footer same profile helper and lime "Start playing". This represents the organizer/player-adaptive option; no organizer no-play option shown on player mock.
All UI text legible exact wording, no cropped screens/buttons, no duplicate screens, no giant surplus whitespace. Professional portfolio-ready mobile interaction design, faithfully aligned to existing Palla palette and visual grammar. This is a concept board, not an implemented app.
